    I = [row[item_ref_col] for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows() if str(row[authorized_col]) == '1']
    cat_of = {row[item_ref_col]: row[category_col] for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    min_i = {row[item_ref_col]: int(row[min_lot_col]) for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    max_i = {row[item_ref_col]: int(row[max_order_col]) for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    u_i = {row[item_ref_col]: int(row[unit_benefit_col]) for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    f_i = {row[item_ref_col]: int(row[item_fee_col]) for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    authorized = {row[item_ref_col]: int(row[authorized_col]) for (idx, row) in items_df.iterrows()}
    cats_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_2_view_0']
    C = [row['category'] for (idx, row) in cats_df.iterrows()]
    a_c = {row['category']: int(row['minimum_quantity']) for (idx, row) in cats_df.iterrows()}
    b_c = {row['category']: int(row['maximum_quantity']) for (idx, row) in cats_df.iterrows()}
    F_c = {row['category']: int(row['activation_fee_cents']) for (idx, row) in cats_df.iterrows()}
    I_cat = {c: [i for i in I if cat_of[i] == c] for c in C}
    res_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_1_view_0']
    R = sorted(set(res_df['resource']))
    L_r = {}
    for r in R:
        total = 0
        for (idx, row) in res_df.iterrows():
            if row['resource'] == r:
                amt = float(row['amount'])
                total += amt
        L_r[r] = total
    usage_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_8_view_0']
    U_ir = {(row['item_ref'], row['resource']): float(row['amount']) for (idx, row) in usage_df.iterrows()}
    bundle_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_0_view_0']
    B = []
    bb_ij = {}
    for (idx, row) in bundle_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        B.append((i, j))
        bb_ij[i, j] = int(row['bonus_cents'])
    incomp_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_4_view_0']
    P = []
    for (idx, row) in incomp_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        P.append((i, j))
    S_ij = {}
    for i in all_items:
        for j in all_items:
            S_ij[i, j] = 1 if (i, j) in P or (j, i) in P else 0
    req_df = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_7_view_0']
    Q = []
    for (idx, row) in req_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_ref']
        prereq = row['prerequisite_ref']
        Q.append((i, prereq))
    D_ij = {}
    for i in all_items:
        for j in all_items:
            D_ij[i, j] = 1 if (i, j) in Q else 0
    M = max(max_i.values())
    m = gp.Model('RIVERSIDE_AUTO_Vehicle_Offer_Selection')
    m.setParam('MIPGap', 0.0001)
    quantity_vars = m.addVars(all_items, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name='')
    activation_vars = m.addVars(all_items, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    cat_activation_vars = m.addVars(C, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    bundle_vars = m.addVars(B, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    obj = gp.LinExpr()
    obj += gp.quicksum((u_i[i] * quantity_vars[i] for i in I))
    obj -= gp.quicksum((f_i[i] * activation_vars[i] for i in I))
    obj -= gp.quicksum((F_c[c] * cat_activation_vars[c] for c in C))
    obj += gp.quicksum((bb_ij[i, j] * bundle_vars[i, j] for (i, j) in B))
    m.setObjective(obj, gp.GRB.MAXIMIZE)
    for i in all_items:
        if authorized[i] == 0:
            m.addConstr(quantity_vars[i] == 0, name=f'unauth_{i}')
            m.addConstr(activation_vars[i] == 0, name=f'unauth_y_{i}')
        else:
            m.addConstr(quantity_vars[i] >= min_i[i] * activation_vars[i], name=f'minlot_{i}')
            m.addConstr(quantity_vars[i] <= max_i[i] * activation_vars[i], name=f'maxorder_{i}')
    for c in C:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((quantity_vars[i] for i in I_cat[c])) >= a_c[c], name=f'cat_min_{c}')
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((quantity_vars[i] for i in I_cat[c])) <= b_c[c], name=f'cat_max_{c}')
    for c in C:
        for i in I_cat[c]:
            m.addConstr(cat_activation_vars[c] >= activation_vars[i], name=f'catact_{c}_{i}')
    for r in R:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((U_ir.get((i, r), 0.0) * quantity_vars[i] for i in I)) <= L_r[r], name=f'rescap_{r}')
    for (i, j) in P:
        m.addConstr(activation_vars[i] + activation_vars[j] <= 1, name=f'incomp_{i}_{j}')
    for (i, prereq) in Q:
        m.addConstr(quantity_vars[i] <= M * activation_vars[prereq], name=f'reqqty_{i}_{prereq}')
        m.addConstr(activation_vars[i] <= activation_vars[prereq], name=f'reqbin_{i}_{prereq}')
    for (i, j) in B:
        m.addConstr(bundle_vars[i, j] <= activation_vars[i], name=f'bundle1_{i}_{j}')
        m.addConstr(bundle_vars[i, j] <= activation_vars[j], name=f'bundle2_{i}_{j}')
        m.addConstr(bundle_vars[i, j] >= activation_vars[i] + activation_vars[j] - 1, name=f'bundle3_{i}_{j}')
    m.optimize()
    return m
